responsibility: Implements GCC’s general IPA propagation infrastructure, especially parameter and call-edge summaries centered on jump functions. It owns node and edge summary storage for actual/formal parameter descriptions, constant and aggregate jump functions, propagated bits and value ranges, IPA-CP transformation summaries, hook registration, summary creation/freeing, call analysis, transformation helpers, and LTO streaming of jump-function data. This file is the shared substrate used by IPA-CP, indirect inlining, predicate remapping, and related interprocedural analyses.
same_name_distinction: Contains the concrete implementation and storage for the propagation framework declared in ipa-prop.h, including creation of node/edge summaries, jump-function analysis and equivalence logic, transformations, hooks, and streaming code.
